subject.title: Telegram group chat history entries lose media data (only placeholder text preserved)

question: Should Telegram retain and replay media from unmentioned requireMention group messages, and if so under what bounded retention policy?
rationale: The code path is clear, but deciding to store media that was not addressed to the bot changes the channel privacy boundary and cannot be reduced to a mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Bounded history media retention
options.body: Retain only admitted local image media in the existing HistoryEntry.media shape with short TTL, media count limits, and live Telegram proof before replaying it into later mentioned turns.

options.title: Keep media fail-closed
options.body: Keep unmentioned group media out of history unless the sender explicitly mentions or replies to the bot, preserving the strictest privacy boundary but leaving this workflow unsupported.

options.title: Require explicit opt-in
options.body: Add or reuse an operator-controlled policy knob for unmentioned group media history before enabling retention, accepting additional config and upgrade-review cost.

recommendation.title: Bounded history media retention
recommendation.body: Retain only admitted local image media in the existing HistoryEntry.media shape with short TTL, media count limits, and live Telegram proof before replaying it into later mentioned turns.

likelyOwner.reason: The current main blame points to Vincent Koc for the relevant Telegram and generic history-media paths, making them the best available routing owner for the policy choice.
